TEACH • DISCUSS • PRACTISE Chapter 1 • Information Technology and Society Algorithmic bias: when AI can be unfair 1-4 • ETHICAL ISSUE 40 What is algorithmic bias? Bias in AI judgments caused by bias in the training data. Example: a hiring AI unfairly rates one gender lower. Where can bias come from? • Training data is biased or incomplete • Past discrimination is reflected in the data • Poor choice of variables • Proxy variables • Model/system design Chapter 1 • Information Technology and Society Privacy, explainability and responsibility 1-4 • ETHICAL ISSUES 41 Privacy Face recognition can identify/track people.
